source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle for each unit with this ability, when this unit is picked to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may use this ability: its ranged attacks get +1 to **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for the rest of the phase.

Mark the unused ability with Ammo Runt tokens beside the unit (as many as you like), and remove them on use.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: no stated duration, so it lasts for the phase it was applied in
